evidence.excerpt: A coextruded film comprising two polyolefin outer plies, two tie-layer plies based on maleic-anhydride-grafted polyethylene, and a central ply of amorphous polyethylene terephthalate of 15–35 µm thickness. The structure achieves an oxygen transmission rate below 50 cm³/(m²·day·bar) at 23 °C while maintaining mechanical recyclability when blended with standard polyethylene recyclate streams at up to 10 % by mass contamination. The claimed invention covers the composition ranges and extrusion temperature windows that prevent crystallisation of the PET ply during processing. Application filed with the Intellectual Property Office of the Republic of Serbia.
